rationale.total_budget: Hard ceiling for one QA request; sub-stages (embedding 60s, retrieval 120s, LLM 150s) cannot stack beyond 180s because the runtime query future is cancelled at the total budget.
rationale.llm_retries: max_retries=2, no model fallback; retries are counted and audited, and a timeout never switches models.
rationale.concurrency: Per-runtime asyncio lock serializes queries to one KB runtime; API-level concurrency is bounded by uvicorn and the runtime manager cache (max 8 runtimes).
